The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal head mounted on a horizontal cantilever arm attached to a vertical pole. The signal head appears to have three lenses, with the top one illuminated red. There is also a smaller rectangular sign or sensor box below the main signal head. In the background, there are trees, buildings, and utility poles.

The small rectangular unit mounted below the main traffic light has ill-defined edges and lacks clear functional features (like a screen or buttons), appearing somewhat generic and softly rendered.
